newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Four girls die, three hurt in Russian camp fire.
newsitem.headline: Four girls die, three hurt in Russian camp fire.

text.p: Four young girls died and three more were rushed to hospital with burns after a fire swept through a children's holiday camp where they were staying, Russia's Emergencies' Ministry said on Monday.
The fire broke out on Sunday night at the camp near the southern Russian city of Voronezh, the spokesman told Reuters. Police are investigating the causes of the incident, he said.
